name: ta.ema
notes: Corrected seeding model (see docs/ECOSYSTEM.md): ta.ema returns na until the bar supplying the length-th valid value, then seeds with ta.sma of the first length valid values (SMA(1,2,3)=2 at bar 2), then applies alpha=2/(length+1)=0.5: bar 3 = 0.5*4+0.5*2 = 3, bar 4 = 0.5*5+0.5*3 = 4. Confirmed indirectly by the PineScript-exported ta.tsi reference vectors (tests/reference-pine-vectors.test.ts), which are only reproducible with this SMA-seed warm-up model.
